TrueLift

Restaurant discounts on Zomato are judged by the orders that use them. TrueLift judges them by the orders they create, inside the owner's OTP approval.

Team Banana, IIT Gandhinagar: Yash Goyal, Bhavay Goyal, Kshitish Madbhavi · IITGN × Eternal hackathon, Round 2

The problem

Since August 2026 a restaurant-funded offer starts only after the owner's OTP. A report counts the orders that used an offer, not the orders it created, so owners approve blind.

One orderFull price₹60 off
Food sales₹400₹400
Discount–−₹60
Commission (25% of the bill)−₹100−₹85
GST on commission (18%)−₹18−₹15.30
Food and packaging (37%)−₹148−₹148
Restaurant keeps₹134₹91.70

₹60 off a ₹400 order pays only if 32 of every 100 orders using it are extra (45 if commission is charged before the discount).

What TrueLift adds

  1. Quote on the OTP screen: a forecast with a range, and a better version of the same discount.
  2. Serve when a customer opens the menu: a lookup; 1 in 10 eligible customers is held out.
  3. Payout: the restaurant pays its own offer, itemised.
  4. Measure every week: extra profit with a range, on WhatsApp; renewal needs a new OTP.

Owners keep their discount size; TrueLift changes who sees it, the minimum order, the time and the Brand Pack reward, or advises no offer.

Results in a simulated market of 300 real Bengaluru listings, a week

218 of 228

TrueLift offers pay for themselves, against 130 of 300 blanket offers.

+₹4.77 lakh

restaurant profit against no offers (+₹2.46 lakh with blanket offers), with ₹5.94 lakh less discount.

+₹6.53 lakh

Zomato commission against no offers (+₹6.45 lakh with blanket offers), in all five market seeds.

How we know

  • The simulator knows the truth: the weekly 80% range held it 79% of the time after one week, 90% after four.
  • Placebo offers that change nothing were paused 1.8% of the time over four weekly looks.
  • On real randomised data (ads, e-mail), uplift models won on Hillstrom's women's e-mail; on Criteo's purchases the simple shortcut won. We report both.
  • We audited our own work: 50 findings, all fixed; what is still not right is published.

What we ask Eternal

  1. Is commission charged before or after the discount?
  2. Could we run our shadow kit on anonymised offer logs for one city?
  3. What does the OTP screen show today, and how often do owners decline?

Try it: https://yashg1836.github.io/truelift/
